paragraphs: Conduent sells front-office and back-office solutions across a diverse range of industries. Its government work is pitched as empowering residents to be engaged members of their communities and lead healthier lives.

Child support offerings are meant to expand and speed payments and services to families. Eligibility and enrollment work simplifies access to services while protecting program integrity. A payments and disbursements line delivers money to the people who depend on it. Transportation offerings cover tolling operations under road usage charging. Transit solutions modernize fare collection for riders. Elsewhere the company automates paper-intensive processes, claiming 99.99% data extraction accuracy.

Published case studies describe strengthening a WIC program for a state health agency. Another describes rebuilding performance and trust in a state Medicaid program. One says the Minnesota Department of Health and Minnesota IT Services moved over two million records to a cloud-based platform. A news item says the company launched Italy's first integrated transit EMV contactless payment system with Brescia Mobilità and Arriva Italia.

quote.text: Empower residents to be engaged members of their communities and lead productive, healthier lives at every point in their journey.
